title: Insolation, heat budget & temperature
quote: Air is heated from below, by terrestrial radiation - not directly by the sun

boxes.title: Insolation
items: Factors: sun's angle, day length, transparency, earth-sun distance
**Perihelion** ~3 Jan, **147 million km**; **aphelion** ~4 Jul, **152 million km**
Max reaches ==**subtropical deserts**== (20-30° N), not the equator
Albedo: ==**fresh snow** highest== (APPSC-G1 2019) > sand > grass > forest > water
High thin clouds warm; low thick clouds cool

boxes.title: Heat budget (of 100 units)
steps: Surface radiates **51**: **17** to space, **34** to atmosphere

boxes.title: Distribution & range
items: Lapse rate **6.5 °C/km**
January isotherms bend ==equatorward over land==, poleward over oceans
**Thermal equator** mostly north of equator
Seasonal range max in ==high latitudes== (APPSC-G1 2023); min at equator
Cloudy nights warmer; clear nights frost
India winter: **20°C isotherm** Tapti mouth → Mahanadi delta

boxes.title: Temperature extremes
items: World: **Death Valley 56.7°C**; **Vostok -89.2°C**
India coldest: **Dras -45°C**
AP hottest **Rentachintala**; coldest ==**Lambasingi**== ("Kashmir of AP")
2026 AP peak: **48.1 °C**, **Piduguralla**
AP Heat Wave Action Plan since **2016**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: APPSC-G2 2023: advection horizontal, convection vertical, insolation direct, conduction lower layers
Departure: heatwave **4.5-6.4°C**; severe > **6.4°C**; or ==**45°C**== actual
UPSC 2024 trap: "heated more by solar radiation" wrong
Without atmosphere: about **-18 °C** vs **+15 °C**
NDMA heat guidelines **2019**; **TRISHNA** (ISRO-CNES)
